Traits.name: Spider Climb
Traits.effectNote: Climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.

Bonus Actions.name: Venomous Spew (Centipede Only)
Bonus Actions.effectNote: Choose one creature the insect can see. On a failed save, it is Poisoned until the start of the insect’s next turn.

Spell.name: Giant Insect
Spell.effectNote: Level 4 Druid conjuration. An action, verbal and somatic components, range 60 ft., and concentration up to 10 minutes. The chosen beast appears in a visible free space within range.

Spell.name: Commands
Spell.effectNote: The beast is allied and acts just after the caster on the same initiative count. Verbal orders cost the caster no action. Without orders it Dodges and moves to avoid danger. It disappears at 0 HP or when the spell ends.
